_comment: LBNL Building 59 rooftop units: overrides for the Brick owner grouping (ingest.brick; runs with group 'brick', one per per-quantity CSV). The dataset's Brick model owns rtu_00N_sa_temp, _ra_temp, _ma_temp and _sf_vfd_spd_fbk_tn by Rooftop_Unit RTU0N (-> AHU-class equipment RTU0N) and gives their roles. It names the OA flow rtu_00N_oa_fr and the OA damper rtu_00N_oa_damper while the CSVs call them rtu_00N_oa_flow_tn and rtu_00N_oadmpr_pct, and it has no point at all for the SAT setpoint (rtu_00N_sat_sp_tn), the RTU's own OA temperature (rtu_00N_oa_temp) or the filtered supply airflow (rtu_00N_fltrd_sa_flow_tn) -- see the data issue brick-point-names-differ-from-csv. Those 20 columns are mapped here: 'aliases' gives the role and 'equipment' the owning RTU, both overriding Brick (each override is reported in the ingest notes). All temperatures are degF and airflows cfm as published. rtu_00N_oadmpr_pct is the OA damper POSITION (%); rtu_00N_oa_flow_tn the measured OA flow (real only from 2020-04-10; the gap fill before is masked by the catalog's fix quirk); the supply-fan speed is the VFD FEEDBACK (one common speed for the four RTUs, 24/7). Not ingested: the underfloor-plenum static setpoint (Brick types it as a duct static setpoint, but this is a UFAD building and the published unit 'psi' does not fit the 0.06 values), the economizer setpoint and the return-fan speed. Dataset: Luo et al. 2022, Sci Data 9:156, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01257-x (Dryad doi:10.7941/D1N33Q).
